install: bun install (isolated Global Store; exact vendor archives)
pods: cd ios && bundle exec pod install
iosDebug: cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace SparklingGo.xcworkspace -scheme SparklingGoInHouse -configuration Debug -destination platform=iOS,id=REDACTED_IPHONE_UDID -derivedDataPath build-device -allowProvisioningUpdates DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=REDACTED_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=15.6 -jobs 4 build
iosRelease: Same xcodebuild flags; scheme SparklingGo, configuration Release
boundedRecording: record start <path> --scope device --fps 30 --hide-touches; open com.probe.e2e --relaunch; snapshot; record stop
